select c.id,c.name,c.type,c.value,c.min_amount,c.start_time,c.end_time,c.total,c.remain, (c.total - c.remain) as receivedCount,c.create_time,count(uc.use_time) as usedCount from coupon c left join user_coupon uc on c.id = uc.coupon_id
and merchant_id = #{merchantID}
and c.name like concat('%',#{pageQueryDTO.keyword},'%')
and c.type = #{pageQueryDTO.type}
and c.start_time > NOW()
and c.start_time < NOW() and c.end_time > NOW()
and c.end_time < NOW()
